reviews.text: We usually have a good experience with the grooming here, but different situation today. Had a confirmed appointment for my dog to get groomed at 8:30. Showed up at 8:30 and there’s no one here. Apparently they don’t open until 9, but why would they confirm an 8:30 appointment they don’t plan to fulfill? I guess I’m supposed to sit here for 30 mins and be late or work or turn around and take my dog home and have to pay a no show fee?? Terrible customer service
Peyton was great. He helped us with our newly adopted big dog.  We will definitely go back.

First time trying Petbar today to give my golden doodle a bath.  The store was clean, well equipped, well organized, and the staff was helpful and well trained.  I'll definitely use Petbar going forward for my dog's baths, and may try out the grooming services in the future.  Welcome to the 'hood.  Best wishes for success.
Used self wash for first time.  It was great!
Peyton was so kind and helpful to make sure our self-serve wash experience was exceptional. The area was clean, and everything we needed was at our fingertips. Highly recommend.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review The! We’re thrilled you had a great experience at petbar and truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We can’t wait to see you and your pup again soon!
Thanks for the 5 stars! 🐾 We love having you and your pet with us at petbar Preston Trail — see you next time! …

Very friendly staff and the place is spotless. The first self pet wash is free.
bathing station were waist high and very comfortable to bath my dog. instruction were demonstrated how to operate the shower and rinse with the hose and temperature of the water.

towels were big and warm. have separate station to finish drying off your pet plus has ear cleaning solution with cotton balls and smell good liquid to spread on you pet and it smells so clean.
Nail trimming is a plus.....
I signed up for monthly service.

Peyton....you are the best.

Betty Simien

Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Edie! We’re thrilled you had a great experience at petbar and truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We can’t wait to see you and your pup again soon!
Peyton and the staff there are amazing!
Linda groomed Bruno today and she did a fantastic job. I love his haircut!! Thank you.
Great service . Linda did an amazing job

Where was this boutique my whole life? Service was excellent, beyond really. Courtney and Ina are the best!!! Prince is my senior really senior… geriatric multipoo and after they rejected him at PetsMart for being too old with truly bad timing because my mother had just had open heart surgery I didn’t know what to do as I travel back and forth from New York but they too needed care and grooming’ these two were literal angels who helped us get them back to clean groomed doggos that was much needed. They treated our 12 year old senior husky like a wonder too. Definitely getting the membership for both and such a blessing to how found this place. I highly recommend, night and day comparison to the the service we got at PetsMart after years of going there and our main poc who cares for our dogs left.
We appreciate the 5 stars, RC! It means a lot to our team and we’re so glad you enjoyed your visit. Thanks for choosing petbar — we look forward to welcoming you back!

We have had the best experience with PetBar off of Inwood and Forest! However, we took our Aussie doodle to the new one on Preston and Campbell and it was not the same. Not only did it take six hours (double the time it usually takes) for them to groom her (we asked them to give her a fresh start and just shave her), but she came home itching like crazy with razor burn and has not stopped for over a week. Very disappointed!!

Shoutout to Payton at PetBar Preston! He is absolutely the best! From the moment we walked in, Payton went above and beyond-showing us around, walking us through everything, and being so incredibly sweet with our puppy boy, Zeus. You could tell he genuinely cares about the animals in his care. We felt so welcomed. We will definitely be back! Ask for Payton. you won’t be disappointed!!!!
Linda was amazing, she did a great job with my massive golden retriever.

We are very happy with how she turned out! We've been taking her to the same groomers for over three years but we're now further from it. I was nervous to go somewhere new but came across Petbar. I am so glad we did try this place because she turned out better than the last place we were taking her to. I showed the groomer one photo and she executed so well!!!

My boy Miko has been coming to this place for almost 2 yrs now and his groomer Linda always leaves my boy looking good👌🏽I appreciate how she does her best to fulfill the specifics I ask for and her attention to detail. She’s definitely good at what she does 👏🏽 I also appreciate the rest of the staff for always having a great personality and welcoming service.
